xna-type.name: LeaderboardEntry
xna-type.summary: Class representing a single row of a leaderboard, holding all the information a specific gamer has uploaded to the board.
xna-type.remarks: Warning This class and all related methods and properties only retrieve a calculated result for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE Services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, the properties in this class will not return a calculated result, and related methods will report a NotSupportedException .

property.name: Columns
property.summary: Provides access to the columns for this leaderboard entry.
property.value: A PropertyDictionary containing columns information for this leaderboard entry.
property.remarks: Warning This property retrieves a calculated result only for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, this property will return immediately with a predetermined default value.

property.name: Gamer
property.summary: Provides access to gamer information for this leaderboard entry.
property.value: The gamer associated with this leaderboard entry.
property.remarks: Warning This property retrieves a calculated result only for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, this property will return immediately with a predetermined default value.

property.name: Rating
property.summary: Provides access to the rating associated with this leaderboard entry.
property.value: The rating for this leaderboard entry.
property.remarks: Warning This property retrieves a calculated result only for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, this property will return immediately with a predetermined default value.
